info.title: boomApp Connect Universal API
info.description: Boost customer engagement with Boomerang SMS, voice, and email messaging workflows through the boomApp Connect API.

post.description: Creates a masked two-way SMS thread in boomApp Connect.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

from.description: Sender number for the masked two-way thread. Required for successful runtime submission.

to.description: Recipient number for the masked two-way thread. Required for successful runtime submission.

reference.description: Reference value for the masked two-way thread. Required for successful runtime submission.

reference_always.description: Whether the reference should always be included.

message.description: Initial message for the masked two-way thread. Required for successful runtime submission.

post.description: Creates a text-to-speech voice call in boomApp Connect.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

voice_intro.description: Welcome message played when the call is answered. Required for successful runtime submission.

message_content.description: Main voice message body. Required for successful runtime submission.

recipient_address[].description: Recipient phone numbers as objects with a number field. Required for successful runtime submission.

voice_thank_you.description: Exit message played after the recipient listens or responds.

voice_retries.description: Retry attempts, maximum 3 per connector schema.

voice_delay.description: Interval between retry attempts in minutes.

email_responses.description: Email address to forward response details.
